note: 1A2 metered gas, OCAC's Total Industry liquid-fuel rows, and - rc46 Wave 2 - the measured HDIP brick-kiln and cement-sector coal: process heat, boilers and kilns on natural gas, furnace oil, diesel, LDO, kerosene, gasoline and coal. Still NOT estimated: petroleum coke (the Comtrade lane) and process bagasse (ceiling-bounded); 'other industrial coal' is definitionally ~zero under the supply-consumption identity.

The heating value is the assumption: OGRA reports a volume and IPCC works in net terajoules. Pakistani pipeline gas runs 900-1,000 Btu/scf and nothing read here pins it. Same treatment as the captive and CNG categories, whose heating values are pinned equal to this one by test.

category: Excluded: fertiliser gas, feed and process fuel (756 MMCFD)
note: Deliberately absent, on the IPCC ammonia method: the TOTAL gas requirement of ammonia production - feedstock and process fuel together, 83.5/16.5 on NFDC's monthly plant annex for this fiscal year - belongs to 2B1, and only separately metered auxiliary combustion outside the process boundary would stay in 1A2.
